debate.title: Can AI prove the hardest open problems in mathematics?
debate.consensus: Leading researchers say recent AI-driven proofs mark a turning point for mathematics. The scale of what AI can now prove has outpaced most predictions.

quotes.role: Complexity theorist, University of Texas at Austin
quotes.quote: I now feel in my bones, for the first time ever, that a proof of P ≠ NP is not far.
